CheckTitle: ECS instances should be deployed within a VPC
Description: Ensure that ECS instances are deployed within a VPC for network isolation, security group enforcement, and controlled connectivity.
Risk: ECS instances not deployed within a VPC may lack network isolation and security controls, potentially exposing them to unauthorized access.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Elastic Cloud Server.
3. Select the instance.
4. Click More > Change VPC.
5. Select the target VPC and subnet.
6. Click OK.

Recommendation.Text: Deploy all ECS instances within an appropriate VPC with proper subnet and security group configurations.
